assets.prompt: Use case: background-extraction / identity-preserve. Edit target is the supplied illustration. Produce a meticulous transparent-background game sprite cutout of the single man in navy hoodie, backpack straps, dark cargo pants, white sneakers. This is a precise extraction, not a redesign or new character illustration. Preserve the original person's face contour, eyes, nose and mouth positions, facial expression, exact hairstyle and hair strands, black fingerless fighting gloves with red trim, original clothing, stance, body proportions and full feet. Keep original drawing and shading as closely as possible. Remove ONLY all background, floor shadow, labels, caption plates and lettering outside the figure. Do not include any other person. Fully include hair, fingers, garments and both shoes with a clean alpha channel, no halo, no floor, no drop shadow, no checkerboard. Center the isolated complete figure in a portrait canvas with a little transparent margin. Do not invent or modify face/clothing. Preserve hoodie chest lettering when present. Output one standalone full-body figure.
